title: Glessner House, Chicago, Illinois, 1945
camera_position: Across Prairie Avenue, looking toward the east facade; inferred from the visible facade.
creator: Unknown photographer
repository: Illinois Institute of Technology, University Archives and Special Collections
collection: Office of Communications and Marketing photographs, 1905–1999
rights_basis: IIT catalog: In Copyright (rightsstatements.org/vocab/InC/1.0/). Medium JPEG publicly displayed; original TIFF marked File Restricted.
found_via: T-2199: supplied IIT lead; public catalog and medium JPEG reviewed 2026-10-09.
notes: Nearly straight-on Prairie facade: ridge caps, three stacks, eaves/gutter, corner downpipe, paired and grouped windows, entrance and boundary stones are readable. Heavy climbing vegetation obscures masonry and openings. The 1945 vegetation, paving and signs are not evidence of their 1904 state. No dimensions or material colors are derived from this monochrome view.

evidence_review.date_basis: IIT dates the photograph 1945; photographer unknown. Catalog building-completion wording is not adopted as a corrected construction date.
